selection_reason: This ACL study examines how KV-cache compression affects LLM jailbreak robustness and proposes Safe-CAM, a cache-merging strategy that restores safety while maintaining compression efficiency with minimal overhead.
title: When Efficiency Meets Safety: A Benchmark Security Analysis of KV Cache Compression in Large Language Models
